steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube the sweet potato, then boil for 10 minutes until soft and drain well.
Mash the sweet potato and cooked lentils together in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Mince the garlic clove and add it to the bowl with the turmeric and ground cumin.
Add the rice flour and coconut milk, then mix until a firm, scoopable mixture forms.
Drizzle the olive oil over the baking sheet and spread it lightly with a brush.
Scoop 16 portions of the mixture onto the sheet and flatten each to about 1.5 cm thick.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once halfway, until golden and firm on both sides.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
